screening_population: newborns >=35 weeks on postnatal ward; antenatal CHD and NICU admission before 4 h excluded
screening_timing_raw: 4-12 h; abnormal first screen repeated 1-2 h later if clinically well
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal SpO2; <95% in either limb or >2% difference abnormal; persistent abnormality on second protocol screen = positive; subsequent paediatrician assessment was downstream evaluation, not a protocol screening repeat
study_target_definition_raw: CHD classified critical if intervention or death within 28 days; source critical lesion set includes hypoplastic aortic arch in addition to standard lesions
diagnosis_categories_raw: source critical/serious/significant/non-significant CHD; significant noncardiac disease requiring intervention; transient/no significant pathology; clinically well downstream reassessment
diagnosis_counts_raw: 360 second-screen persistent positives = 189 source 'true positives' +171 clinically well downstream reassessments; among189: CHD21, significant noncardiac156 with CHD overlap11, residual no-significant-pathology respiratory-symptom group23; among171: 169 remained without diagnosis and 2 later had CHD detected via murmur
individual_diagnoses: source critical CHD6 = HLHS1, hypoplastic aortic arch1, IAA1, CoA1, critical PS2; other positive-screen CHD = AVSD3; significant CHD6; non-significant CHD6; two later CHD among clinician-reclassified 171 not lesion-identified but detected by murmur
lesion_mapping_status: HLHS1 + IAA1 are unconditional harmonized CCHD. CoA1 + critical PS2 satisfy the conditional <=28-day rule because the source defines these cases as critical using intervention/death within 28 days. Isolated hypoplastic aortic arch is not in the locked target and remains in denominator. The only source CCHD among negative POS was a critical CoA presenting in collapse at day12; therefore the two CHDs later detected by murmur among the 171 clinician-reclassified infants are non-CCHD under the source critical classification and remain denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: Unique actionable union among the 189 source true positives =156 significant noncardiac cases needing further intervention +21 CHD requiring outpatient follow-up -11 overlapping infants =166. Removing five harmonized CCHD leaves CAN-AB161. This includes the non-target hypoplastic-arch infant, which had early cardiac intervention, and all other non-target CHD with documented follow-up. The two later CHDs among the 171 were detected through a murmur rather than through the failed-screen pathway -> CAN-U2. Twenty-three infants had brief respiratory symptoms/2-day antibiotics but explicitly no significant pathology -> aggregate NON_CAN23. The other 169 were explicitly clinically well with normal oxygen saturation on downstream assessment and no later diagnosis.
entry_hold_reason: Phase4 entry denominator flag resolved: the protocol itself defines persistent abnormality on the second screen as positive; therefore 360, not the authors' downstream clinician-selected 189, is the locked final-failed-screen count
poolability_reason: exact final-fail denominator reconstructed from source algorithm; point harmonized target count; complete terminal classification; well-baby postnatal population with pre-screen NICU exclusion; early 4-12 h timing retained as heterogeneity covariate
source_full_text_provenance: Singh Y, Chen SE. Eur J Pediatr. 2022;181:813-821. PMID 34618229; PMCID PMC8821483; DOI 10.1007/s00431-021-04275-w. Open-access Springer/PMC primary HTML independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict161/355; Expanded163/355; NON_CAN23; explicit clinically-well/no-diagnosis169. The source's 189 'true positives' are a downstream clinical reclassification and are not substituted for the protocol-defined 360 final failed screens.

site_program: Ataturk University Medical Faculty, Erzurum high-altitude neonatal cohort
screening_algorithm_raw: combined oxygen-saturation plus peripheral-perfusion-index screening; exact POX-only contribution to the combined positive group is not separable in the accessible primary report
study_target_definition_raw: CCHD screening using combined SpO2 and perfusion index; no CCHD detected
diagnostic_category_exclusivity: combined screening positive21; no CCHD; PDA10 overall, of whom9 were in the positive-screen group; remaining12 positive-screen infants not clinically characterized in accessible report
lesion_mapping_status: PDA9 among combined-screen positives; 12 other combined-screen positives uncharacterized
management_actionability_evidence: No CCHD was detected, but the report evaluates a combined SpO2+perfusion-index screening strategy and the accessible source does not establish that all 21 positives were POX final failures. A POX-specific harmonized denominator therefore cannot be created.
ascertained_cchd_negative_failed_screens: The nine PDA findings have no documented hemodynamic consequence or qualifying management and would be NON_CAN if they were confirmed POX failures; the other 12 combined-screen positives remain clinically uncharacterized. These conditional classifications are not converted into a CAN-CCHD effect because POX-specific membership is unresolved.
source_full_text_provenance: combined POX+perfusion-index positivity cannot be separated into the review's POX final-failed-screen denominator; outcome classification is also incomplete
extraction_notes: Tekgunduz KS et al. Eur J Pediatr. 2021;180(1):31-38. PMID 32504134; DOI 10.1007/s00431-020-03698-1. Primary abstract and Springer publisher preview independently reverified.
qa_status: Preserve descriptively for altitude/PDA context: 21 combined-screen positives, no CCHD, PDA9 among positives. Do not assume 21 are all POX failures and do not generate a meta-analysis weight.

site_program: West Virginia statewide Birth Score CCHD screening program
screening_population: well-babies in newborn nurseries; infants born in/admitted to NICU within first24 h not eligible
screening_timing_raw: CDC-recommended newborn screening timing; exact ages not captured in first-year dataset
screening_algorithm_raw: CDC/DHHS recommended pulse-ox screening algorithm; failed screen prompted TTE recommendation
study_target_definition_raw: source defines CCHD as CHD requiring surgery or catheter intervention within first year, broader than locked 28-day target
diagnosis_categories_raw: source CCHD; non-CCHD structural findings; pulmonary hypertension/PPHN; failed screens without TTE
diagnosis_counts_raw: 19 failed; TTE available17; source CCHD7. TTE diagnoses: HLHS+TAPVR1; PA+hypoplastic pulmonary artery stenosis1; truncus+IAA1; critical CoA+VSD1; TAPVR1; HLHS1; TGA+VSD1; source non-CCHD = ASD/low-normal function2, Ebstein mild+TR/PFO1, ASD+PDA1, PPHN+PDA1, VSD+PFO1, ASD1, PFO1, PH+bidirectional PDA1, PFO1; no TTE2
individual_diagnoses: HLHS+TAPVR; PA+pulmonary artery stenosis; truncus+IAA; critical CoA+VSD; TAPVR; HLHS; TGA+VSD; mild Ebstein; PPHN; pulmonary hypertension; ASD/VSD/PDA/PFO findings; two no-TTE failures
lesion_mapping_status: Definite harmonized CCHD among evaluated infants = HLHS case2 + IAA-containing case1 =3. Pulmonary atresia lacks septal anatomy and may add one target case if PA/IVS. Critical CoA and TAPVR are conditional but the source's first-year CCHD definition does not establish <=28-day intervention/death, so they remain denominator. TGA+VSD is not simple TGA and remains denominator. The two no-TTE failures can themselves be harmonized CCHD or CCHD-negative, yielding total harmonized CCHD3-6 and denominator13-16.
management_actionability_evidence: No treatment/escalation/disposition or required follow-up consequence is linked in the primary report to the CCHD-negative diagnoses. CAN-U=6 if PA is harmonized CCHD, or7 if PA remains denominator: mild Ebstein, PPHN, pulmonary hypertension, re-entered CoA, TAPVR, TGA+VSD, plus PA when applicable. Seven incidental ASD/VSD/PDA/PFO-dominant findings are NON_CAN. If either/both no-TTE cases are harmonized-negative they remain UNKNOWN.
poolability_reason: well-baby setting is appropriate, but pulmonary-atresia anatomy and two no-TTE final failures prevent a point harmonized denominator; ascertainment can fall below 90% in admissible scenarios
source_full_text_provenance: John C et al. W V Med J. 2016;112(4):42-46. PMID 27491102. Full journal article/table independently reverified from author-uploaded/public full-text copy.
extraction_notes: Detailed source flow governs: 19,283 infants were eligible/in the program data frame, but 17,120 had an actual classified screening result =17,101 pass +19 fail. Abstract wording uses 19,283 as screened; Phase5 uses the detailed flow. Strict0 throughout. Expanded6-7 with denominator13-16. Two failed infants lacking TTE remain in the final-fail flow rather than being deleted.

site_program: Birmingham Women's Hospital routine POS program
screening_population: eligible babies >34 weeks; infants admitted to NNU before screening excluded; representative report captures only babies subsequently admitted because a positive POS required investigation/treatment
screening_timing_raw: usually 4-8 h; as early as 2 h for homebirth/early discharge
screening_algorithm_raw: PulseOx algorithm: <95% either limb or >2% difference on two occasions, or any <90%; all test-positive babies reviewed, but only those requiring further investigation/treatment were admitted and captured by the study database
total_screened: 49375 livebirths; exact screened count not reported
final_failed_screens: not reported for all final fails; admitted test-positive subset253
study_target_definition_raw: Ewer/PulseOx target exactly matches locked lesion list and <=28-day conditional rule
cchd_negative_final_failed_screen_denomi: full final-fail denominator not recoverable; admitted harmonized-negative subset245
diagnosis_categories_raw: CCHD; serious/significant CHD; respiratory illness; PPHN; sepsis; transitional circulation
diagnosis_counts_raw: among253 admitted positives: CCHD8, serious CHD9, significant CHD5, other significant diagnosis225, transitional/no pathology6; 247/253 had significant condition requiring treatment; 239/253 received supplemental oxygen
individual_diagnoses: CHD table: TGA2; critical PS1; PA2; PS1; CoA3; truncus1; AVSD2; TOF2; AS1; tricuspid abnormality1; PDA2; VSD3; ASD1; plus noncardiac respiratory/infective/PPHN diagnoses
lesion_mapping_status: The source uses the same Ewer/PulseOx CCHD definition as the review lock and reports eight CCHD within the admitted positive subset, so admitted-subset harmonized CCHD=8 and admitted harmonized-negative subset=245. This does not repair the missing denominator of all final failed screens.
management_actionability_evidence: Within the admitted subset, 247/253 had a significant diagnosis requiring treatment. After removing the eight harmonized CCHD, all remaining 239 significant-diagnosis infants are Strict CAN-CCHD; six had transitional circulation/no pathological diagnosis and are NON_CAN. However admission itself occurred only when further investigation/treatment was required, so this 239/245 yield is outcome-selected and cannot estimate CAN-CCHD among all final failed screens.
entry_hold_reason: R014 overlaps Apr-Jul2013 and is support/sensitivity replacement only; R027 remains representative and no counts are summed
poolability_reason: the report identifies only positive-screen infants admitted because further investigation/treatment was required; test-positive infants observed without admission are not enumerated. The study therefore selects on the review outcome and lacks the full final-failed-screen denominator
source_full_text_provenance: Henderson A et al. Arch Dis Child Fetal Neonatal Ed. 2022;107(3):256-261. PMID 34686534; DOI 10.1136/archdischild-2021-322303.
